title: Yosemite Falls Landscape, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photograph CA
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photograph capturing Yosemite Falls in Yosemite National Park, California. The cascade cuts through dramatic granite rock faces framed by tall pine trees in the foreground. The photo features deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century family album prints, capturing the enduring popularity of American national park road trips during the post-WWII travel boom.
